app.name: HomeDaemon
app.offline: You are offline. Changing chores requires a connection.
app.offlineReadOnly: Showing the last loaded data. Some actions are unavailable while offline.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage the household chores.
login.invalidCredentials: The email or password is not correct.

changePassword.title: Choose a new password
changePassword.subtitle: This account must change its password before it can be used.
changePassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

password.needsUppercase: Add at least one upper-case letter.
password.needsLowercase: Add at least one lower-case letter.

onboarding.title: Create your household
onboarding.subtitle: Set up the shared household. You can change these settings later.
onboarding.adminRequired: An administrator has to create the household before anyone can use the app.
onboarding.name: Household name
onboarding.timeZoneHint: Used for calendar dates, the daily window and job times.
onboarding.currencyHint: ISO 4217 code, for example EUR. Used by the budget module.
onboarding.nextSteps: Next, add the people of the household under Settings → People. Chores and the budget both need them.

chores.title: Chores
chores.empty: No chores yet. Create the first one.
chores.emptyFiltered: No chore matches the current filters.

field.title: Title
field.effortWeightHint: Optional. Not every minute costs the same.
field.anchorDateHint: Used by fixed schedules and as the creation reference.

validation.durationInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes.
validation.durationTooLong: A chore cannot last more than a day.
validation.effortWeightInvalid: Enter a number greater than or equal to zero.
validation.frequencyRequired: Choose how often the chore repeats.
validation.modeRequired: Choose how the next date is counted.
validation.assignmentRequired: Choose who can do the chore.
validation.assigneeRequired: Pick the person for a single-person chore.

recurrence.rollOnCompletion: Counts from the day it is done

complete.title: Mark as done
complete.dateHint: Defaults to today in the household time zone.
complete.alreadyRecorded: This chore was already recorded for that day.

delete.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
delete.body: The chore disappears from the catalog and the plan, but its completion history is kept. You can restore it later.

planner.title: Planner
planner.runInterrupted: The recalculation is still running. Refresh in a moment to see the result.
planner.calendarUnavailable: Calendar availability is unavailable, so these figures come from the daily window alone.
planner.empty: Nothing is planned in this window.

unscheduled.title: Could not be placed
unscheduled.empty: Every chore in this window was placed.

move.title: Move or reassign
move.hint: This locks the occurrence until it is completed or unlocked.
move.invalid: Choose a date and a person.

household.title: Household
household.name: Name
household.timeZoneHint: Used for calendar dates, the daily window and job times.
household.currencyHint: ISO 4217 code, for example EUR. Used by the budget module.
household.planningHorizonHint: How far ahead the planner looks for chores.
household.maxHint: Optional. Leave empty to use the whole daily window.

validation.timeZoneRequired: Enter a time zone, for example Europe/Rome.
validation.currencyInvalid: Use a three-letter code such as EUR.
validation.horizonInvalid: Enter a whole number of days.
validation.windowOrder: The window must end after it starts.
validation.capInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes, or leave it empty.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.subtitle: Rooms group chores and guide the planner.
rooms.name: Name
rooms.deleteBody: A room can only be deleted while no chore uses it.

members.title: People
members.subtitle: People who can receive chores.
members.name: Name
members.todoListHint: For example todo.alice. Planned chores are written here.
members.calendarsHint: One per line, for example calendar.alice_work.
members.pickFromHomeAssistant: Start typing or pick an entity from Home Assistant. You can also enter an id by hand.
members.deleteBody: Only a person with no chores and no completion history can be deleted.

validation.colorInvalid: Use a hex colour such as #4F46E5.
validation.entityTooLong: Keep the entity identifier under 200 characters.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Everyone signs in with their own account.
accounts.temporaryPasswordHint: Shown once. Hand it to the person; it must be changed at the first sign-in.

validation.displayNameTooLong: Keep the display name under 200 characters.

budget.title: Budget
budget.subtitle: Shared expenses split by income and settled with transfers.

field.subcategoryOptional: Optional. It must belong to the chosen category.
field.name: Name
field.settlementYearHint: The year this transfer settles. It may differ from the payment date.

summary.noIncome: No income has been recorded for this year, so the shares cannot be computed yet.
summary.provisional: The balance is provisional: some income months are still missing.
summary.settled: Everything is settled for this year.
summary.emptyCategories: No expense has been recorded for this year.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.subtitle: Every shared expense, newest first.
expenses.cancelBody: The expense is removed and the yearly balance is recomputed.

expenseForm.noParticipants: No one takes part in the budget yet.
expenseForm.saved: Expense saved. Add the next one.

incomes.title: Incomes
incomes.subtitle: Net monthly income per person. It sets the whole year's proportion.
incomes.retroactive: Every income you enter re-splits all the expenses of the year, including the ones already recorded.
incomes.noParticipants: No one takes part in the budget yet.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.subtitle: Real money movements that settle a year's balance.
transfers.cancelBody: The transfer is removed and the yearly balance is recomputed.

import.title: Import expenses from CSV
import.subtitle: Administrators can import any CSV with one expense per row.
import.fileHint: The first row contains the column names. Quoted values, comma or semicolon separators and European amounts such as € 7,99 are supported.
import.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
import.emptyFile: The file has no header row or no expense rows.
import.unreadableFile: The file could not be read as a CSV.
import.mapColumnsHint: Choose which column holds each value. Unused columns can be ignored.
import.mapPeopleHint: The names in the file are matched to budget participants. Choose the right person for every name.
import.noPayers: The file has no payer names.
import.mapCategoriesHint: Names that already exist are matched automatically. Review them, or create the missing ones.
import.done: Imported {{imported}} expenses. {{skipped}} already existed and were skipped.

categories.title: Budget categories
categories.subtitle: Categories and subcategories used to classify expenses.
categories.empty: No category yet. Add the first one.
categories.deleteBody: A category can only be deleted while no expense uses it.

validation.amountPositive: The amount must be greater than zero.
validation.samePerson: The sender and the receiver must be different people.

errors.notFound: This page or item does not exist.
errors.offline: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.conflict: That change conflicts with the current state.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this action.
